ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigmentation (approx. 95%) with sparse, high-intensity specular highlights (approx. 5%) from water droplets.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 20 pixels along the superior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, complex, high-contrast brown and tan pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, vertically-oriented linear disruptions in the dark pigmentation visible on the central-left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) on the distal tips of both lobes and visible rake-like abrasions on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive water sheeting and cascading droplets across the fluke surface creating transient high-intensity pixel noise.
